english.title: Operator of non-UK registered public transport aircraft fail to provide aerodrome information to crew
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) were the

(A)_[operator]_
(B)_[pilot in command]

of a public transport aircraft registered elsewhere than in the United Kingdom, namely **(..SPECIFY AIRCRAFT..), which flew in or over the United Kingdom when

(C)_[you]_
(D)_[the operator]_

had not made available to the flight crew aerodrome operating minima which complied with article 132(3) of the Air Navigation Order 2016 for every aerodrome at which it was intended to land or take off and every destination alternate aerodrome
english.legislation: Contrary to articles 132(2) and 265(6) of the Air Navigation Order 2016.
